title: Block-level Word content controls are dropped
reasoning: OOXML allows content controls (w:sdt) to wrap block-level paragraphs/tables and table-cell content. blocksFromBody and parseTable only accept direct w:p or w:tbl children, so text inside common form fields or protected regions wrapped by w:sdt is omitted from the normalized model and therefore from snapshots/diffs.
reproduction: Wrap an otherwise valid paragraph as <w:sdt><w:sdtContent><w:p><w:r><w:t>Approved</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:sdtContent></w:sdt> in the document body. parseDocx returns no block for that content.
recommendation: Unwrap w:sdt by recursing into w:sdtContent wherever block children are scanned, preserving document order for paragraphs and tables.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The Word tests cover direct paragraphs, tables, hyperlinks, and simple tracked changes, but not block-level or table-cell content controls.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add body-level and table-cell w:sdt fixtures asserting their contained paragraphs/tables are parsed in order.
minimumFixScope: Extend the Word adapter's body/table child walkers to handle w:sdtContent recursively.
